fact: The World Bank report of December 2023 says the implementation of UNESCO's contract for the reinforcement of the education ministry MEPU-A's EMIS is facing delays, and that the first phase of the contract on assessing the ministry's information system management is being implemented, with the schools-with-net-accessible-indicators measure at 0.00 against a 90.00 target.

Educationactu reports that since 2024 Guinea's education ministry, through the DGECS, has run a platform (dgecsecoles.com) giving each pupil a matricule number and holding exam marks, enrolling grades 7 and 11 in 2024-25 and extending to intermediate primary and secondary classes except grade 9 in 2025-26.
